notes.title: The Dragonhood 2.0 Update - Major gameplay changes
notes.notes:
Full Changelog below 👇

Dear Dragons Enjoyers, 
I have been receiving complaints about certain things regarding the gameplay since the release. I was silent, and you shall know, that honest work is a soulmate to silence! (same as money)

Firstly, The Dragonhood is finally receiving a proper gameplay trailer, better late than never...
[previewyoutube=Tv6-SkK3XsE;full][/previewyoutube]
When it comes to the most important changes, the biggest one concerns issues with end game. I know that I didn't finish the game completely and it actually ended after killing a CERTAIN EVIL GUY.

Now I have made sure that it will take a little longer to [strike]completely destroy game systems and mechanics[/strike] enjoy the game.

MYTHIC AND HEROIC DUNGEONS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758134/16628f48bf4e2187d395dc0f4e71c86ced536a16.png

NEW AMULETS PROGRESSION
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758134/dacd5165413798b4187b37e90362f728d89ae500.png

INFINITE TOWER
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758134/8b25db78377c9fb7043a362ad6139aa4397151e6.png

ASCENSION SYSTEM
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758134/dca8fb712323c90e41a00e90914ac70a1ff42eab.png

ATTRIBUTES' UPGRADING CHANGES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758134/1da35d5343615327fc79e0bc9a010d446f82126e.png

Now dragon receives 4 attribute points to spend on each level up and you can't upgrade them for gold. (Don't worry, Bamboo is still the play)

Many of you complained about inflation, annoying amulets selling, lack of sorting options and repetitive dragons' healing. These were also fixed!

FULL CHANGELOG

Items:

 Hellbrewed Tequilla doesn't have negative effect anymore
 Bamboo change
 new sorting options
 new item types: normal, heroic and mythic

Features:

 dungeons difficulties and new items' system based on that
 infinite end game tower
 dragons ascension (infinite dragon reverting for bonuses)
 new sound effects

Major changes:

 you can no longer upgrade attributes for gold
 dragons are now rewarded with 4 attributes points to spend per level up
 inflation does not longer scale with action points wasted
 new scriptorium upgrade
 dodge and crit chance nerf (due ascension and tower features)
 selling moved to vendor tab and now works with right click to sell
 heal all button
 plot changes

Other:

 game now is being saved automatically on each day finish
 added sorting/filters when sending dragons
 Knowledge is Power and Wisdom Dragon perks changes
 new achievements
 round counter
 each dungeon got another 2 new layouts that are being drawn randomly
 stuns nerf
 quicker animations in dungeon
 propably a few bugs fixed

notes.title: The first trailer ever release!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The year 2023 is coming to an end so it's a great occasion to release the first ever trailer for The Dragonhood. It sums up a total of 10 months of development and I am super proud of it, even if it isn't the quality I wanted. This year was busy and it was harsh developing such an ambitious project in the spare time. There is still much to do before the final release in the July and I am super excited for the upcoming features that aren't shown in the trailer! I hope this year was productive for you aswell and you are proud of what have you accomplished. I wish you that 2024 will be the same or even better!

[previewyoutube=ub6PCTJvudU;full][/previewyoutube]
Do not hesitate to wishlist if you like it!

HISTORY CONTENT
As we sign off the 2023 I would like to share with you a progress during the year, so here are some screenshots from early days of the production of The Dragonhood:
